title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 279 (Telegram-Style Swipe & Red Field Highlights)
highlights: Telegram-Style Smooth Tab Swipe: Real-time 1:1 finger tracking swipe across bottom navigation tabs (Dashboard <-> Invoices <-> Customers <-> Products) with zero lag and full page state preservation.

Persistent Red Outlines & Fill for Missing Fields: Missing required form fields (Customer Name, 10-digit Mobile, Products cart, Address, GSTIN) display persistent red borders and soft red fill until typed, avoiding disappearing snackbar confusion.
Job Sheet Validation: Instant validation feedback with red borders for missing customer details, mobile number, and problem description.
Isolated In-App Updater: Background downloader installs Android APK directly with chunk progress bar and one-tap install prompt.
fixes: Replaced gesture recreation with hardware-accelerated PageView swipe navigation.
Added persistent red outline and fill validation across Mobile Sales and Mobile Job Sheet.
